title: Spell Shop at Dusk
description: A mysterious old wooden shop facade at night with a large oval sign reading 'SPELL SHOP LOCKED FUSIONS & STASIS VIALS'. A cloaked figure stands in the open doorway holding a small glowing vial. The storefront is filled with shelves of magical potions, specimens, and occult symbols under lantern light.
prompt: A moody nighttime view of an ancient timber-framed spell shop with a large oval hanging sign that reads 'SPELL SHOP LOCKED FUSIONS & STASIS VIALS' surrounded by bats and bones. A cloaked figure stands in the open arched doorway holding a glowing potion vial. Windows display shelves filled with labeled magical bottles, roots, butterflies, and specimens. Lanterns cast warm light on the weathered facade and stone steps scattered with papers and a broom. Dark fantasy atmosphere with cool moonlight and warm interior glow.
